items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And the whole thing is based on one of the songs, the first song on the record, I think, on Live at Willisau.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, I see how that makes sense. Yeah, he’s, you know, from Texas. Swing his ass off, play some blues shouts, and he played the freer stuff with a flair. Cause there’s a record that he did, one of my favorite records, it’s just him and Blackwell live in Willisau, Austria. And I wrote this tune…. What’s the name of that tune? (whispers this) “Citizen Tain,” I think. And the whole thing is based on one of the songs, the first song on the record, I think, on Live at Willisau. It’s not a note by note ripoff,…
Early on you had the opportunity to share the stage with Sonny Rollins. Talk about Sonny.
